notes: Fixed additive effects only: intercept plus one effect per displayed attribute. Winter excluded because climate determines it.

Current river levels use the World Builder ownable-only bitmap, including junction promotions. The presence-only control uses presence from that same bitmap; the native control retains vanilla geography and river presence. Bitmap levels are predictions, not a fresh engine export.
Coefficients are centred to a training-frequency-weighted mean of zero within each attribute; the intercept is the shared reference.
Prediction bounds apply even to unobserved attribute combinations. Fertility effects on multiplier must be nondecreasing; no arbitrary crop or terrain ranking is imposed.
Base-unit coefficient caps and 400,000 upper bound are exploratory game-design assumptions, not historical measurements.
Region-grouped five-fold validation holds entire regions out. Region, population, coordinates, location size, culture, crop system and improvements are never predictors.
Targets are the current equal-area game model, not independently measured population capacities.
